# Specialization in International Tax Management

SNIES 102966, Medellin

A world in which businesses are multinational requires people with an analytical criterion to understand local and international taxes and manage global tax situations. In our specialization we focus on an integral analysis to manage taxes from laws, their regulations, jurisprudence and doctrine, as well as the understanding of the bilateral effects of taxes on commercial transactions.

If you are accountant, lawyer, economist, administrator or you have an interest in understanding the international tax field because you work or are the owner of a company that is globalizing, you have allies or clients abroad, and in general you are interested in foreign investment, the opening of new markets and negotiation, this is the specialization indicated for you **.**
